title: Free disk space used by Docker images and build cache
summary: Docker keeps old images and build cache that can fill the disk. This shows how much space Docker uses, then removes only unused images and build cache.

aliases.text: docker takes too much disk space
free space used by docker images
docker no space left on device
docker занимает много места на диске
docker съел все место на диске

prerequisites: Docker Engine is installed and running
Your user is in the docker group, or you can use sudo

steps.explain: Show how much space Docker uses, split into Images, Containers, Local Volumes and Build Cache. This is read-only and deletes nothing. Note the RECLAIMABLE column.
steps.expect: A table with rows Images, Containers, Local Volumes and Build Cache, and columns TOTAL, ACTIVE, SIZE and RECLAIMABLE.

alternatives.explain: If Docker says 'permission denied', run the same read-only check with sudo.

steps.explain: Remove dangling images, which are old untagged leftovers of rebuilt images. Images with a name and tag and images used by containers are kept. Docker asks for confirmation: type y and press Enter.
steps.expect: A confirmation question about removing dangling images. After y, the output lists deleted image IDs and ends with 'Total reclaimed space'.

alternatives.explain: If Docker says 'permission denied', run the same cleanup with sudo.

steps.explain: Remove build cache that is no longer used by any build. Next builds may be slower, but no images or containers are removed. Docker asks for confirmation: type y and press Enter.
steps.expect: A confirmation question about removing unused build cache. After y, the output lists cache entries and ends with 'Total:' and the reclaimed size.

alternatives.explain: If Docker says 'permission denied', run the same cleanup with sudo.

verify.expect: The RECLAIMABLE values for Images and Build Cache are smaller than in the first check.

rollback.explain: Removed dangling images and build cache cannot be restored. If you need an image again, pull it with docker pull or rebuild it with docker build; the next build simply starts with an empty cache.

warnings: Removed images and build cache cannot be restored. Pulling or rebuilding them can take a long time and needs internet access.

Run the cleanup only when you no longer need the removed leftovers. Do not add extra options to these commands; cleanup options that remove all unused images or Docker volumes can delete data you still need.
Docker volumes hold data such as databases. This card does not touch them; keep it that way.
